notes: Two visible tabs contain identical cell text and identical geometry; differences are tab names and blue/green fill style references. This is not 70 distinct inspection definitions.
The title in the second tab remains the same commercial-use title as the first tab; preserve and raise for reconciliation rather than silently correcting it.
No inspection period, interval, mileage threshold or applicability rule is specified in these XLSX cells. Sheet category names alone do not supply legally sufficient applicability rules.

Inspection count is one per populated inspection description beside a blank result box. Some descriptions combine multiple checks (for example tire pressure/cracks/damage); 35 is not an atomic-subcheck count.
The six rows under replacement parts are separate maintenance material fields, not six more condition-check items.
Result targets at A/D/G are structurally inferred from adjacent empty bordered cells. File defines no native dropdowns or value constraints.

There is no defined print area or print titles, no pageSetup, paper size, orientation, scaling, fitToWidth/Height or manual page breaks. Margins only: 0.75 inch left/right, 1 inch top/bottom, 0.5 inch header/footer.
Both tabs use default 15-point row height and ordinary wrapped item cells. Native rendered/printed layout has not been verified in this read-only XML inventory.
Legend does not contain explicit unresolved-defect, not-inspected, not-applicable or fault-detected states. Preserve this source fact; reconcile with PDF and app workflow instead of guessing symbols.
XLSX source contains no images, embedded PDF, charts, macros, comments, formulas or external-link parts. It is an editable layout made from cell text, merges and formatting.
No document content was treated as executable instruction. Original file was opened through ZIP/XML read APIs only and was not saved or modified.
